about: The one curated source for where the Tear program stands. docs/POSITION.md is rendered from this file by `pnpm position:render`, and `pnpm check:docs` fails when the rendered file is stale or was edited by hand. Each area records its state in a few words, what is true now, the next step, what only the owner can do, and evidence: repository paths that exist, or links to pull requests. Change this file in the same pull request that changes an area's state, update `curated` when you review the whole file, and re-render.

production.note: Production still runs the 2026-08-30 build. Everything merged since then, including the release-readiness program, is on main but not deployed.

areas.name: Release readiness
areas.summary: Pull request 85 merged the release-readiness line on 2026-11-13 (developer surfaces gated out of release builds, menu UI rebuilt, startup payload 4.13 MB to 2.10 MB, offline cache 14.77 MB to 6.74 MB, new code-budget, determinism and architecture gates). Follow-ups 86, 87 and 89 to 92 merged the same day (runtime split, one world constructor, Prettier). The phase table in the plan still shows the pre-merge states.
